Name: Moon's Haley Portraits for Seasonal Cute Characters
Author: SunMoonStars60828
Description:
[size=4]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/size]
This mode requires the portraiture mod to work properly, and, of course, the Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]. Please go give their mod lots of support! They are amazing and they totally deserve it. The portraiture mod comes with instructions when installed, but in short, this mod must be placed in whichever folder you keep your portraiture portraits in. If you want to use this mod but not seasonal outfits, simply rename the portraits that you will be using to match those you'd like them to replace, but I do recommend using them with the mod for the best experience.

Thanks for the support![url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]
